brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 哪个目标对得上的已知少？

t.zh: 一个 ? 留在两个目标里时，先证哪一个，就由哪一个来定它。逆用<part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref>、再拼成以后，两个目标是 ?t是人、?t喜欢安。<part-ref to="part:assumption"></part-ref>取第一条对得上的已知：先证「?t是人」，?t 就成了茜，可茜不喜欢安，第二个目标便证不下去。
t.en: When a ?-letter sits in two goals, whichever is proved first settles it. After <part-ref to="part:exI"></part-ref> and Join backwards the goals are ?t is human, ?t likes Ann. <part-ref to="part:assumption"></part-ref> takes the first given that fits: prove “?t is human” first, and ?t becomes Cy, who does not like Ann, so the second goal cannot be proved.

t.zh: 新元件「目标后移」：把第一个目标移到最后。
t.en: A new part, “Defer”: it moves the first goal to the end.
